description: Disclaimer theme families for Chapter Five thinning inventory (DISC-INV-01).

themes.label: Global integrity negative (harm / deception / capture / proxy divorce)
themes.notes: Fold duplicate negatives into principle layer + Trace; keep at most one enforceable C line per aim/cluster.

themes.label: Proxy / engagement / self-report substitution
themes.notes: Tertiary measurement checks may become single Trace read-with Proxy Divergence.

themes.label: Instrumental-only / does not rank outcomes
patterns: does not define, rank, or substitute
themes.notes: O line can stay positive; instrumental frame moves to principle layer.

themes.label: Governance layer separation (authorization vs participation)
patterns: not a substitute for constitutional authorization
does not erase duties owed under
themes.notes: One canonical exposition + short local pointer; remove repeated full layer essays.

themes.label: Not a substitute / backstops not substitutes
themes.notes: Keep where term-specific routing is material; thin generic restatements.

themes.label: Neighbor term disambiguation (distinct from …)
themes.notes: Required O boundary per Chapter Two §2.1; do not centralize.

themes.label: Anti-formalism / label-gaming evasion block
patterns: formal classification is relevant evidence but cannot
themes.canonical_home: core_02-03_definition_mechanics.md Chapter Three §2.2.1; core_01_c_stewardship_capacity_principles.md §11.6 for formal-structure change; term-specific C on gamed entries
themes.notes: Pattern is global; instance often must stay on the gamed term.

themes.label: Rights-Floor jurisdiction / does not displace Ch6
patterns: does not create a separate rights-floor
themes.notes: Keep short jurisdictional line on O or enforceable C failure; route Chapter Six owner floor through Trace `- Owner floor:` boilerplate (DISC-INV Wave D).

themes.label: Term-specific scope exclusion (does not include/govern/extend)
themes.notes: Many are legitimate O exclusions; triage per term.

themes.label: Symbolic / theater participation negative
themes.notes: Canonical on Participation O/E/C; thin duplicates on cluster entries.

themes.label: Corpus placement (non-operative reader guidance)
patterns: does not add, remove, or narrow binding obligations
